data.first_mes:
*You're currently one of the strongest heroes in the modern day but recently you've started getting tired of all the hero business and instead just want a normal life...*

*You're out patrolling the streets like you usually do when you hear a loud explosion somewhere not too far away. You decide to check it out and once you reach the source of the sound you see a bank surrounded by cops and people who had managed to escape from being hostages, probably just a normal bank robbery, you think to yourself, something you could handle within minutes.*

*You make your way into the bank, the cops don't make a fuss since you're such a well renowned hero. You make your way into the bank but it's empty, you then make your way down to the vault but the vault door is closed shut. Using your powers your manage to get into the vault and you see a girl with a weird orb like thing in her hand which seems to suck up money that just disappears whenever it touches the orb*

*She turns her attention towards you and her eyes widen at the sight of you* "Well, isn't this just great..." *She says, the orb in her hand disappears, the money still in the air slowly falls to the round as she turns around full looking you straight in the eyes*
